name: Building Fire
description: A fire breaks out in a densely built area, consuming wooden structures and displacing families.

name: River Flood
description: Swollen rivers burst their banks, inundating low-lying neighborhoods and destroying crops in the floodplain.

name: Earthquake
description: The ground shakes violently, toppling buildings and rupturing gas lines across the city.

name: Tornado
description: A violent funnel cloud tears through the outskirts, ripping roofs from buildings and scattering debris for miles.

name: Hurricane
description: A massive storm makes landfall, bringing catastrophic winds and a devastating storm surge that reshapes the coastline.

name: Blizzard
description: A brutal winter storm buries the city under feet of snow, halting commerce and stranding residents in their homes.

name: Drought
description: Months without rain parch the land, drying up wells and withering crops across the region.

name: Heatwave
description: Temperatures soar to dangerous levels for weeks, overwhelming hospitals and buckling rail lines.

name: Disease Outbreak
description: A virulent illness spreads through crowded quarters, overwhelming clinics and forcing quarantines across affected districts.

name: Wildfire
description: A wall of flame races through the surrounding wilderness, consuming homesteads and blanketing the city in choking smoke.

name: Landslide
description: Rain-soaked hillsides give way, sending mud and rock cascading into neighborhoods built on the slopes.

name: Tsunami
description: A towering wall of seawater surges inland without warning, obliterating the waterfront and sweeping entire blocks out to sea.

name: Economic Recession
description: The economy contracts sharply as businesses shutter, unemployment lines grow, and consumer confidence collapses.

name: Economic Boom
description: Prosperity sweeps the city as wages rise, new businesses open on every corner, and construction cranes dot the skyline.

name: Stock Market Crash
description: Panic selling wipes out fortunes overnight as the stock exchange plummets, dragging the real economy down with it.

name: Oil Price Shock
description: Global oil prices spike overnight, sending fuel costs soaring and squeezing every industry that depends on cheap energy.

name: Housing Bubble
description: Inflated property values come crashing down as overleveraged buyers default, leaving half-built developments abandoned across the city.

name: Technological Breakthrough
description: A local inventor's breakthrough puts the city on the map, attracting talent and investment from across the nation.

name: Major Startup IPO
description: A homegrown startup goes public, minting millionaires and flooding the local economy with sudden new wealth.

name: Major Factory Closure
description: The city's largest employer padlocks its gates for the last time, throwing thousands out of work and gutting entire neighborhoods.

name: Trade War
description: Retaliatory tariffs choke off trade routes, leaving warehouses full of goods that can no longer reach their markets.

name: Currency Crisis
description: The local currency plunges in value, wiping out savings and sending the price of imported goods through the roof.

name: Bank Run
description: Panicked depositors line up around the block to withdraw their savings before the banks run dry.

name: Automation Wave
description: Machines replace thousands of workers seemingly overnight as factories and offices automate their most routine jobs.

name: Foreign Investment Surge
description: International capital pours in, funding gleaming new developments and creating thousands of jobs across the city.

name: Tourism Boom
description: The city becomes a destination as visitors flock to its attractions, filling hotels and breathing life into the local economy.

name: Cryptocurrency Crash
description: Speculative digital fortunes evaporate overnight, leaving a trail of bankruptcies and a generation of disillusioned investors.

name: Workers' Strike
description: Workers walk off the job demanding better pay and conditions, bringing key industries to a grinding halt.

name: Civil Protest
description: Citizens take to the streets, voicing their grievances and demanding change from city leaders.

name: City Festival
description: The city comes alive with music, food, and celebration as residents gather for the annual festival.

name: Pandemic
description: A deadly contagion sweeps through the population, overwhelming hospitals and forcing the city into prolonged lockdown.

name: Sports Championship Win
description: The home team brings the trophy back to the city, igniting wild celebrations and a surge of civic pride.

name: Housing Crisis
description: Skyrocketing rents and a dire shortage of affordable units push working families to the margins of the city.

name: Housing Shortage
description: Vacancy has collapsed while residential demand stays hot — families compete for every available unit and rents climb block by block.

name: Baby Boom
description: Birth rates surge as optimism and prosperity encourage families to grow, straining schools and pediatric clinics.

name: Brain Drain
description: The city's brightest graduates leave for better opportunities elsewhere, hollowing out the skilled workforce.

name: Anti-Gentrification Protest
description: Long-time residents rally against displacement as rising property values and luxury development transform their neighborhoods beyond recognition.

name: Immigration Wave
description: Waves of newcomers arrive seeking opportunity, bringing diverse skills and traditions but straining housing and services.

name: Refugee Crisis
description: Displaced families fleeing conflict abroad arrive in large numbers, testing the city's capacity for compassion and resources.

name: Cultural Festival
description: The city celebrates its diverse heritage with a vibrant festival of music, art, and cuisine from around the world.

name: Pride Parade
description: Rainbow banners line the streets as thousands march in celebration of identity and inclusion, drawing visitors and media attention.

name: General Election
description: A heated general election is dividing the city along ideological lines.

name: City Referendum
description: A contentious referendum on city expansion is splitting public opinion.

name: Whistleblower Exposé
description: A city employee has leaked documents revealing misuse of public funds.

name: State Visit
description: A foreign head of state is visiting the city, boosting its international prestige.

name: Corruption Scandal
description: A widespread corruption ring has been uncovered in the city administration.

name: Constitutional Crisis
description: A power struggle between city institutions has paralyzed governance.

name: Military Parade
description: A grand military parade draws crowds and stirs patriotic sentiment.

name: Bribery Scandal
description: Senior officials caught accepting bribes from construction firms.

name: Water Main Break
description: A major water main has burst, flooding streets and cutting supply to thousands.

name: Bridge Collapse
description: A critical bridge has collapsed, severing a major transportation link.

name: Dam Failure
description: The city dam has breached, sending a wall of water downstream.

name: Pipeline Leak
description: A gas pipeline rupture is contaminating soil and threatening nearby residents.

name: Nuclear Incident
description: A radiation leak at the power plant has triggered an evacuation zone.

name: Grid Overload
description: Surging electricity demand has overwhelmed the power grid, causing rolling blackouts.

name: Tunnel Collapse
description: A major tunnel has caved in, trapping vehicles and halting underground transit.

name: Road Collapse
description: A sinkhole has swallowed a section of road, revealing crumbling infrastructure below.

name: Construction Accident
description: A crane collapse at a major construction site has killed workers and damaged nearby buildings.

name: Citywide Blackout
description: The entire city has lost power after a catastrophic transformer failure.

name: Gold Rush
description: Prospectors flood in after gold is found in the surrounding hills.

name: Railroad Expansion
description: A new rail line connects the city to the national network, transforming trade.

name: Automobile Boom
description: Affordable automobiles are reshaping how citizens live and commute.

name: Television Era
description: Television ownership explodes, reshaping culture and political campaigning.

name: Internet Revolution
description: High-speed internet transforms commerce, communication, and daily life.

name: Social Media Crisis
description: A viral social media scandal is damaging the city's reputation worldwide.

name: AI Automation Wave
description: Artificial intelligence is automating white-collar jobs at an unprecedented pace.

name: Space Launch
description: The city's aerospace facility successfully launches a rocket, capturing global attention.

name: Climate Summit
description: The city hosts an international climate summit, drawing world leaders and activists.

name: Quantum Breakthrough
description: A local lab achieves quantum computing supremacy, attracting global investment.

name: Film Premiere
description: A major film premiere draws celebrities and media attention to the city.

name: Grand Music Festival
description: A massive outdoor music festival attracts tens of thousands of visitors.

name: Food Festival
description: A week-long food festival celebrates the city's culinary diversity.

name: Art Exhibition
description: A renowned art exhibition opens, elevating the city's cultural standing.

name: Fashion Week
description: Designers and models descend on the city for a glamorous fashion week.

name: Carnival
description: A riotous carnival fills the streets with music, costumes, and revelry.

name: Heritage Day
description: The city celebrates its founding with historical reenactments and ceremonies.

name: Championship Victory
description: The city's team wins the national championship, sparking mass celebration.

name: Olympic Bid
description: The city launches an ambitious bid to host the Olympic Games.

name: Stadium Disaster
description: A structural failure during a packed match causes a deadly stampede.

name: Team Relocation
description: The city's beloved sports team announces it is relocating to another city.

name: World Cup Host City
description: The city is selected to host matches for the World Cup, triggering a construction boom.
